about: Blocking rules. An enemy attack gets an incoming zone (enemy_dirs) while it winds up; the player blocks by holding Guard with the cursor on that zone.

columns.kcd2_value: Value read from KCD2 (kcd2_sources id and how), or '-'
columns.er_mechanism: How the mod makes it happen (hooks.id)

rows.when: Enemy attack connects while the player guards
rows.effect: Normal Elden Ring guard (the weapon's own guard absorbs the hit)

rows.when: Enemy attack becomes active while the player guards
rows.condition: cursor zone != incoming zone (and the incoming zone is known)
rows.effect: The guard opens for this attack: the guard input is withheld from the game until the attack ends, so the hit lands

rows.when: Enemy hit lands on the guard
rows.condition: zone matches AND guard was pressed no earlier than the perfect window before the hit
rows.effect: No stamina lost to the hit, enemy staggers, riposte window opens
rows.kcd2_value: perfect_block_timing: median(block_time_to_hit - block_time_to_start) over all rows (KCD2 1.5.6 has no player rows; 206 NPC rows give 0.515 s)

rows.when: Attack pressed inside the riposte window
rows.effect: Elden Ring's guard counter for the equipped sword plays instead of the zone swing
rows.kcd2_value: perfect_block_timing: median(block_time_to_end - block_time_to_hit) over all rows (1.15 s on KCD2 1.5.6)
